bullets.text: APL Apollo promoter Gupta family reportedly exploring a 28.2% stake sale, deal above Rs32.7k cr with open offer; no buyer named.
bullets.source: Nuvama - Nuvama Daily | Top Buy/Avoid | Nuvama Strategy | Company update- Whirlpool

Financing a Rs36-39k cr control deal limits buyers
Stock near ATHs at a rich multiple; OI rose sharply into the news

Prefers buying dips at Rs2,150-2,175 after company clarification

bullets.text: 3Q cement prices are up 5% qoq (Rs15/bag, Rs240/t ex-GST); IIFL sees industry Ebitda/t recovering from Rs850 to Rs1,000.
bullets.source: IIFL - Cement - Dealers Price checks - Prices hold in Nov; 3Q pricing up 5% qoq

detail.summary: November prices were flat in the first half, but the October hike has largely held. Fuel costs added Rs80-100/t of pressure in Sept-Oct, yet the price increase and operating leverage could still lift industry Ebitda/t. Dealers expect volume targets to take priority, so further hikes are unlikely before December.
points: All-India prices +0.5% vs end-October; Patna and Indore fell
Hike largest in West and East, then Central, North, South
2Q Ebitda/t fell Rs200 to Rs850 on fuel and operating leverage
East players Nuvoco and Dalmia benefit most if hike sustains
Picks: UltraTech, JK Cement (execution); Dalmia, JK Lakshmi (valuation)

points: Option 1: 10-12 Dec; Option 2: 10-13 Dec
Panna runs 2 clinker lines, scalable to 4
Last PhillipCapital visit was December 2023

bullets.text: IIFL cuts Kaynes FY27/28/29 EPS 35%/8%/7%, retains ADD with TP Rs3,647 (26% upside); core EMS grew 34% yoy at 13.2% OPM.
bullets.source: IIFL - The Front Page: TATATECH; MSUMI; KAYNES

detail.summary: IIFL's interaction with the Kaynes Semicon CEO points to the Vishay relationship scaling ATMP capacity multi-fold over five years. Near-term stock performance is seen as event-driven, with the Gridcrest divestment and the OSAT JV as the catalysts. A new auditor should ease governance concerns.
points: EPS cut 35% FY27, 8% FY28, 7% FY29; ADD, TP Rs3,647

detail.summary: Management at CLSA's India Forum saw no demand-side constraints across core EMS verticals, with supply of components and chemicals the near-term limit. Data centres and PCBs are emerging growth vectors, supporting the US$1bn FY29 and US$2bn FY32 revenue targets.

Organic EMS capex Rs1.0-1.5bn, funded by internal accruals
Selective M&A in aerospace, IT and high-end power modules

bullets.text: Elara webinar: RE bidding fell from 40.6GW in FY25 to about 15GW in FY26; 40-45GW of awarded capacity is unsigned.
bullets.source: Elara - Renewable Energy Webinar - Firming the renewables: Grid & Storage Imperatives-KTA

detail.summary: The webinar's argument is that RE additions will moderate because PPA/PSA delays and transmission constraints are holding back awards. Tendering is shifting to firm power (RTC, FDRE, solar plus storage). Storage is scaling fast, but merchant BESS economics rest on today's wide peak spreads.

BESS commissioned 14,543MWh (Sep-26)
Transmission needs 24-36 months; constraints persist 1-2 years
FDRE tender discovered about Rs5.25/unit; new thermal about Rs6+

bullets.source: Kotak - Kotak: Hotels - Luxury Rules ; Whirlpool ; Auto market shares ; TCS - CFO meeting notes ; TATA Tech - lofty aspirations

Management expects AI-led revenue deflation to continue but at a moderating pace as the first round of productivity pass-through is already in contracts. Medium-term margin aspirations are unchanged despite near-term headwinds from growth investments and M&A.

Infosys pipeline replenished, some mega deals
